verdict.rationale: BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is documented as a data exchange where analysts can discover curated third-party and Google datasets and combine them with their internal data without replicating it. Providers can also monetize listings via Google Cloud Marketplace. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace experience, and documented detail on subscription and join mechanics for enrichment.

support.subject: As an analyst, a marketplace of third-party datasets lets me enrich my own data directly inside the platform

citations.quote: Puoi utilizzare BigQuery sharing per scoprire set di dati curati di terze parti e di Google e combinarli con i tuoi dati interni
BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is a data exchange platform that lets you securely share, discover, and access data across organizational boundaries without replicating data.
Listings let you share data without replicating data, and you can monetize listings on Google Cloud Marketplace
